title: Cherished by the Sea Pet‑Friendly 2‑Bedroom Seaside Rental
meta_description: Enjoy Cherished by the Sea, a pet‑friendly 2‑bedroom Seaside vacation rental with Gulf views, a wraparound balcony, and walk‑to‑everything access. Plan your Seaside stay today.
description_expanded: 119 QUINCY CIRCLEPrime Ruskin Place Location in the Heart of SeasideCherished by The Sea is a beloved, pet-friendly Seaside vacation rental perched above the iconic shops of Ruskin Place—one of the most sought-after locations in Seaside, Florida. With charming town views and views of the Gulf from both the living room and bedroom, plus unbeatable proximity to Central Square, Ruskin Park, and the beach, this second-floor condo places you at the center of Seaside’s vibrant coastal lifestyle. Guests are just a half block from the Seaside Amphitheater and only one block from beach access at Coleman Pavilion.Expansive Wrap-Around Balcony with Town & Gulf ViewsOne of the standout features of Cherished by The Sea is the oversized wrap-around balcony, accessed through a private exterior stairway entrance. This furnished outdoor retreat offers multiple lounging and dining areas, including an outdoor dining table, Adirondack seating for four, and three chaise loungers. From here, guests can enjoy elevated views of Seaside’s town life along with Gulf views, all while soaking in refreshing coastal breezes. It’s the perfect setting for morning coffee, sunset cocktails, and front-row people-watching in the heart of town.Open-Concept Living with a Modern Beach VibeInside, the condo features a bright, open floor plan that seamlessly blends the kitchen, dining, and living areas. The updated full-size kitchen includes bar seating for three and everything needed for easy coastal meals. Adjacent, the dining area comfortably seats six, making it ideal for shared meals after a beach day. The living room is anchored by a sectional sofa that converts to a queen sleeper and is filled with natural light. From this space, guests can enjoy views of the Gulf through multiple sets of French doors, which also provide direct access to the wrap-around balcony.Two Private Bedroom Suites for Comfort & PrivacyThe primary king suite offers a peaceful retreat with Gulf views, a flat-screen TV, dresser, ample closet space, and a private ensuite bathroom with a single vanity and tub/shower combination. A convenient stackable washer and dryer is tucked into the closet for guest use.The second bedroom features a queen bed, mounted flat-screen TV, private closet, and its own ensuite bathroom with a tub/shower combo. French doors from this bedroom open directly onto the wrap-around balcony, extending the indoor-outdoor living experience and allowing guests to enjoy town and Gulf views from the comfort of their suite.Walk-Everywhere Seaside LifestyleCherished by The Sea offers a truly walkable Seaside experience. Guests are steps from Ruskin Park, half a block from Central Square and the Seaside Amphitheater, and moments from over 40 shops and dining options. With the beach just one block away, you can park your car and enjoy Seaside entirely on foot or by bike.Whether you’re traveling with your four-legged companion or simply seeking a front-row seat to Seaside’s charm, Cherished by The Sea delivers an unforgettable stay in one of the town’s most iconic locations.Must be 25 years of age to rent and sign the registration. 3-night minimum Spring, Spring Break | 5-night minimum Summer | 3-night minimum Fall | 2-night minimum Winter. No children ages 13-19 during Spring Break season.* Pets are allowed with certain restrictions and provisions. An additional $50 per day rental pet fee will be collected, in addition to the flat $125 pet fee, for 2-bedroom homes. Pets will not be allowed on furniture. No pet over 20 lbs. Only one dog allowed.FEATURES1,000 square feetSeaside Beach Access at Coleman Pavilion176 yards or a 3-minute walk to beach accessLarge wrap-around balconyGas grillPeacock Alley Linens – fresh and luxurious Peacock Alley towels and sheets throughout the homeAccess to 3 swimming pools, 4 clay tennis courts & 3 Pickleball courts (court fees apply), and a fitness centerWelcome tote with 2 beach towels, a complimentary bottle of wine & 2 complimentary rental bikes for pickup at Seaside Transit AuthorityPersonalized service throughout your stay with starter amenities provided2 parking passes for two-bedroom and larger homes are issued. A golf cart is considered a car. Golf carts for non-homeowners visiting Seaside are prohibited. Special circumstances and medical needs requests require a golf cart permit. Additional parking can be found in the parking lot next to Early Morning Hours or other available spaces along Quincy Circle, or additional vehicles can pay the daily rate to park in the paid parking areasPet-friendly up to 20 lbs. and only one dog
